description.text: Why choose to study this program?This program is offered by School of Mechanical Engineering and Automation, one of the most powerful college of Beihang University and among Rank 8 in mechanical engineering programs.Main CoursesMechanical Drawing, Mechanics of Materials, Theoretical Mechanics, Science of Engineering Materials, Theory and Machines and Mechanisms, Fundamentals of Manufacturing Engineering.Internship and Career DevelopmentAdvanced engineering and technical personnel having basic knowledge and applied ability in machinery design and manufacture, and being able to work in the first line as to design and manufacture machinary, develop science, apply research, manage operations and other aspects in the fields of mechanical manufacturing.Diploma AwardedBachelor of Engineering

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. The page with personal information in the ordinary passport (the expiry date should after September 30th, 2025) (Applicants in mainland China also need to submit the copy of the current valid visa page or residence permit page)2.Highest Education Diploma or Certificate of expected graduation date from the high school studying currently can also be accepted (the original high school graduation certificate will be verified at the time of registration)3. The transcripts that covers all subjects in the period of high school4. Foreigner Physical Examination Form and the Report on Blood Examination within the validity period of 6 months (Applicant need to download the Foreigner Physical Examination Form and go to the local regular medical institution to conduct physical examination according to the items listed in the form. The examination results should be filled in Chinese/English, signed and sealed by the doctor and medical institution) Click here to download "Foreigner Physical Examination Form "5. The results of TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or English Proficiency Certificate for the applicant whose native language is not English (90 or above in TOEFL, 6 or above in IELTS, 105 or above in Duolingo)6. Financial guarantor letter Click here to download the template of "Financial Guarantee Letter"7. Financial guarantor proof (bank deposit of no less than 4 years tuition fee or annual income of no less than 30000 RMB)8. Birth certificate of the applicant9. The documentation of the nationality of the applicant's parents when applicant birth (including passport, ID card, the proof of permanent resident abroad, etc.)10. The certificate of Non-Criminal Record within the validity period of 6 months issued by the local public security authority11. An Integrity Commitment Letter to ensure the authenticity of all the application materials you provide Click here to download the Integrity Commitment Letter template12. Applicants under the age of 18 till September 1, 2025 should submit the notarial certificate of Guardian's Guarantee. The guardian should be an adult who lives in Beijing with financial resources. Click here to download Procedure of Guardian Notarization Documents for the Applicant under the Age of 1813. Other documents required by Beihang University

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, with proper moral conduct, friendly to China, between the ages of 18 and 22, and have attained a senior high school diploma.2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport , meet the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC .3. Applicants who’s native language is not English should submit the results of TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or English Proficiency Certificate (90 or above in TOEFL, 6 or above in IELTS,105 or above in Duolingo)
